ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 65% of the visible surface area, creating a stark macro-level contrast against the low-intensity dark gray/black pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and along the peripheral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters detected at the extreme distal tips (points) of both the left and right lobes, characterized by irregular, textured pixel masses exceeding the standard fluke boundary.
